theorems.name: Submission.iwl_zero_dim_integrality
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Xj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U 0) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Xj j)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ j, (Xj j).massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Xj X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X
